verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a built-in assistant, Gus the AI Benefits Assistant, which gives personalized benefits guidance and builds a ready-to-submit benefits package, so delegation to an in-product assistant exists but only within the benefits domain. The MCP and Claude/ChatGPT connections are external AI tools rather than a built-in assistant, and payroll automations and invoice ingestion are adjacent automation features, so none of these count toward this story. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that takes tasks across payroll, HR, and compliance; documentation of how delegation works inside the app; independent or hands-on corroboration of Gus.
